query.site_id: optional integer; defaults to resolved current site
query.content_language_code: optional content language code; defaults to site default content language
query.ui_language_code: optional admin interface language code: fr | en

data.group_key: site | languages | backoffice | public_ui | localization | seo | media | articles | relations
data.language_code: optional language code used by localization updates
data.values: object matching the selected schema group; server-side validation is authoritative
data.content_language_code: optional content language code used by localization updates
data.ui_language_code: optional admin interface language code used to localize configuration labels

fields.label: string
fields.type: text | textarea | number | boolean | select | language | media | array | site_asset | color
fields.validation: object; select fields may expose options, preview_query_parameter and, for public_ui.active_theme_key, appearance_defaults

values.articles: object containing article detail defaults: visible metadata toggles, date format and JSON-LD author policy
values.public_ui: object containing show_login_shortcut, show_site_title_in_header, active_theme_key, body_font_family, heading_font_family, main_heading_font_family, main_heading_letter_spacing and hex color fields; active_theme_key may expose validation.appearance_defaults keyed by theme
